definitions.explanation: A decorative arrangement of cut flowers tied or wrapped together.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}に{花束|はなたば}を{贈|おく}った。
examples.english: I gave her a bouquet of flowers.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}で{花束|はなたば}をもらった。
examples.english: I received a bouquet at the graduation ceremony.

examples.japanese: {花束|はなたば}を{作|つく}ってもらえますか。
examples.english: Could you make a bouquet for me?

notes:
COMPOUND: {花|はな} (flower) + {束|たば} (bundle)

COMMON OCCASIONS FOR {花束|はなたば}:
- {誕生日|たんじょうび} (birthday)
- {卒業式|そつぎょうしき} (graduation)
- {結婚式|けっこんしき} (wedding)
- {発表会|はっぴょうかい} (recital, performance)
- お{見舞|みま}い (visiting someone in hospital)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花束|はなたば}を{贈|おく}る/{渡|わた}す (give a bouquet)
- {花束|はなたば}をもらう (receive a bouquet)
- {花束|はなたば}を{持|も}つ (hold a bouquet)

RELATED:
- {花|はな} (flower)
- {花屋|はなや} (flower shop)
